A note from the author

Worlds flowing from the tip of my pen…

I’m Coffee Shirone, an upcoming webwriter. I write stories drawn to the strange edges of reality: forgotten gods, impossible dreams, old cities, and people searching for meaning in a universe that may not answer.

This page is a small archive of the worlds I’m building, the names I write under, and the stories I hope you’ll carry with you after the final page.

Imagination brought to the world through my words.

Dark fantasy, web novel

Diverof TheCosmos

A journey into a world where the line between dream and reality grows thin, and every answer seems to open the door to a deeper mystery.

By Coffee Shirone

Synopsis

Diver of The Cosmos

The despair of being abandoned, how does it feel? Why is waking up in this dream, no less than a curse? What are the anomalies haunting every sight of mine?

Waking up in an everlasting dream, Shen Huoxing stepped onto the ashes of those who wished to survive, perhaps more than him.

Surrounded by dreamers, delusions and an unpierceable, high and bright sun, Shen Huoxing, facing the curse of being an infiltrator to his family, finds himself stuck— somewhere between the chaos of a madness, far louder than any.

Holding the artifact, The Root, he climbs the chains of anomalies, hiding before him— in the hopes of finding the mastermind, hidden beneath the flow of time.

This is the tale of a Diver, diving through one cosmos to another, he is none other than a ‘Diver of The Cosmos’.

Interested? This web novel releases Feb 2027!
